description: What a YouTube channel can post right now. A YouTube target's options live under options.youtube on the post: made_for_kids (true or false, required: ask the person, never assume), privacy (one of privacy_options), title (up to 100 characters; the post's name by default), contains_synthetic_media (true for realistic AI-made or AI-altered people, places or events), tags, category_id. While public_uploads is false every upload goes up private, to be made public in YouTube Studio.
name: youtube_options
title: YouTube posting options
